reference.description: Short citation (first author et al., year). Example: Liu et al., 2018

location.description: Geographic location / land use of the sampled site(s). Example: Vegetable farmlands, China

polymerTypes.description: All polymer types identified, with abbreviations as reported. Example: Polypropylene (PP); polyethylene (PE); polyester (PES)

identificationMethod.description: Technique used to identify/confirm polymers. Example: µ-FT-IR; stereomicroscope + FTIR

digestionMethod.description: Chemical digestion used to remove organic matter, or "NA". Example: 30% H2O2

densitySeparation.description: Density separation solution and density, or "NA". Example: saturated NaCl (1.19 g/cm³)

measurements.description: Return ONE object for EACH distinct soil/field type or sampling stratum the study reports a microplastic concentration for (e.g. shallow soil vs deep soil, or orchards vs paddy fields vs vegetable plots). If the study reports only one overall value, return a single object.

fieldType.description: The soil layer, land use, or stratum this row describes. Example: Shallow soil; Deep soil; orchards; paddy fields

mean.description: Mean abundance for this stratum, with ± SD if reported. "NA" if not given. Example: 78.00 ± 12.91

unit.description: Unit of the abundance values. Example: items kg⁻¹

evidence.description: For each key finding, the exact text snippet copied verbatim from the PDF that supports it. Used for verification.
